summary: Iteration 18 verifies the Correct-Score/Cards/Corners mapping fix, name-keyed player odds matching, unpriced-panel note, no-integer-OU rule, odds-version cache + recalculation, and LION-ticket parlay sanity. 8/8 new backend tests pass. Full prior suite still green. Frontend confirms snapshot banner + 4 unpriced notes + 95 .gr links on Specific Bets and 158 .gr links on LION Tickets, with ZERO non-Greek bookmaker links on either page.

evidence.frontend_lion_tickets_scrape: 158 .gr links, 0 banned links, snapshot banner present
evidence.lion_tickets_parlay: Every parlay.odds <= product(leg_odds)+0.01; singlesReturn==sum, singlesMultiple==avg (<=0.05 tol); edge consistent with lion - 100/odds (<=0.6pt).

critical_code_review_comments: apifootball._af_pick now strictly maps 'Cards Over/Under' / 'Total Cards' (NOT 'Home Team Total Cards') — fixes the old 'card in b' loose test that attached team-cards lines to the match-cards market.
apifootball._af_pick rejects integer OU lines (line*2%2 != 1) across goals/corners/cards/handicap — prevents the exact-number push risk.
apifootball.player_key collapses 'Z. Vipotnik' / 'Zan Vipotnik' / 'Vipotnik, Zan' to the same `initial|surname` key; verified against live priced rows.
specific_bets._apply resolves pn:<key>:<market> for player rows using the player field; after pricing, any panel with 0 priced rows is annotated with the explanatory note.

rapid_books.odds_version() returns `{max_snapshot_at}_{int(time/1800)}` so cache keys roll both on provider refresh AND every 30-min window; /api/specific-bets cache key `sb_out_{match_id}_{odds_version}` and /api/lion-tickets key `lion_tickets_{odds_version}` both honour it — repeat calls return byte-identical payloads.
lion_tickets parlay now multiplies ROUNDED (displayed) leg odds so parlay.odds cannot exceed the product shown to the user — verified across all tickets.
APPROVED_BOOKMAKERS (backend) and bookmakers.js MAP (frontend) still mirror the same 17 Greek-licensed ops.
context_for_next_testing_agent: live_af_1563195 (Millwall vs Swansea) is the canonical rich-coverage fixture: expect panels Correct Score 8/8, Cards 4/6, Corners 20/20 and players ~48/88 priced; Fouls/Offsides/Goalkeeper Saves/Score-At-Any-Time stay unpriced BY DESIGN and must show 'No bookmaker prices this market for this fixture — LION's own probability only.'. odds_version() shape is '{at}_{bucket30m}'. Specific-bets endpoint can take ~90s on cold cache; use 180s timeout + retry. Keep ingest focused: do not fan-out to many fixtures (RapidAPI monthly quota).
rca of the issue: N/A — iteration 18 verifies E1's mapping/caching fix. The old `'card' in b` test matched 'Home Team Total Cards' alongside 'Cards Over/Under', scrambling the Cards panel; integer OU lines also leaked. Fix: strict bet-name equality for Cards/Corners + half-line-only guard. Player markets had no ids, so a name_key (initial|surname) is emitted on both sides and matched inside _apply(). Recalculation on new odds is driven by odds_version() entering the cache key for both /api/specific-bets and /api/lion-tickets.
